prior_work: Funding data already existed in active_v9 and BTC Flow; do not call the data source itself novel. PR129/130 fast-price and flow predictions failed. economic_hypothesis: A rising spot asset with relatively inexpensive/negative perpetual funding might offer less crowded upside than a similarly rising, expensive asset. Pure negative funding may just identify weak assets, so price trend confirmation and a matched price-only control are required. Funding is information ONLY: the spot account receives no funding payments.
source_limits: Prior studies motivate cross-sectional comparison, not this strategy or500%profits. Contemporaneous correlation is not future alpha. Funding can be capped and reflects more than trader crowding.

features: Own-asset positive21/63day momentum and close>SMA50,full201day prices,30dayquote-volume>=5m. Momentum score is equal average21/63 log-return divided by trailing60dayvol*sqrt(window). Seven-day funding average gets a cross-sectional rank and a trailing90day percentile, ties midpoint. Cheapness=1-0.5*crossrank-0.5*own_history_percentile. Primary score=momentum_crossrank+cheapness. persistence: Top3 equal slots. Retain a previously selected asset while eligible and ranked in top5; replace only invalid/top5-exiting members, empty slots stay cash.
